items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: We had Jackie Robinson. How about that. So it’s changing.

ctx.x: Did the same thing happen in New York?

Yeah well that’s not music that’s just culturally the way things have evolved. You know. Queen Elizabeth, her son’s children, from where they had to go from where I had to go, it’s different because of the cultural — and it just happens to be — now if you go over to Egypt and your skin’s white, you might be a second-class citizen because you’re not the right religion. So it just happens that we’re talking about white and black. But it’s very clear how that is the way it is. George Washington, was he Chinese?…

Do you think it will always be that way? No, well, I apologize, because you already answered that question. You’re talking about a progression. And just because something is the way it is now, it may change. But —
